title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the statistical bias and root-mean-square error (RMSE) in estimating downstream racial disparities (e.g., Democratic party affiliation by race, socioeconomic status by Asian subgroup) by comparing predictions from the list-powered Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (ℓBISG) method against ground-truth self-reported race data in U.S. voter files and historical census records.

Evaluating the statistical bias and RMSE in estimating downstream religious disparities (e.g., age composition across different sects in Lebanon) by comparing ℓBISG probabilistic predictions against ground-truth self-reported religious sect data from the Lebanese voter registry.
